purpose: Locate wall time in the real training path. These are independent stochastic runs, not identical-input backend comparisons.
warmup: No epochs excluded from the records. Article table shows zero-based epoch 2; first epoch includes initial JIT calls.

timings.seconds_total: Wall time around train_one_epoch. Excludes backend import, environment construction, save/load and the final evaluation.
timings.rollout_seconds: Collection of 20000 transitions, including policy.act, environment step/IPC, and rollout buffer work.
timings.update_seconds: PPO.update, including preparation/GAE, shuffling/indexing, and 40 optimizer steps.
timings.other_seconds: seconds_total minus rollout_seconds and update_seconds. Includes scheduled evaluation, progress display and logging.

evaluation: 100 fresh stochastic episodes at epoch 0 and after save/load. Three-epoch probes are not convergence runs.
initial_runs: First Torch run and the first four-thread tinygrad failure used 8f0b31a. The initial failure has only a config record because error logging was not yet implemented.

failed_run.location: Replaying cached beam-search options during PPO.prepare, before any epoch completed.
